map.你家阳台适合养什么花？输入朝向、楼层与季节，估算每日直射光照时长，推荐适宜植物与: Which flowers suit your balcony? Enter the orientation, floor and season to estimate daily direct sunlight hours and get recommended suitable plants with care tips.
map.📚 深度解析：阳台光照时长估算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Balcony Sunlight Duration Estimation
map.南/北向阳台直射差异评估: Assess the difference in direct light between south- and north-facing balconies
map.高层/低层遮挡影响判断: Judge the impact of high-rise versus low-floor obstruction
map.按朝向（南/东/西/北）、楼层（低层易受遮挡、高层更通透）与季节，估算每日直射光: Estimate daily direct sunlight hours by orientation (south/east/west/north), floor (low floors are more obstructed, high floors more open) and season: a high south-facing balcony gets about 6-8h in summer and 4-5h in winter; a north-facing one gets diffuse light all day with no direct sun.
map.南向 6 楼、夏季：估算每日直射约 7h → 适合月季、茉莉、番茄等喜阳植物；同: South-facing 6th floor in summer: estimated about 7h direct light daily → suits sun-loving plants such as roses, jasmine and tomatoes; under the same conditions winter is about 4.5h, so switch to short-day flowers such as kalanchoe and succulents; a north-facing balcony can only grow shade-tolerant plants such as ferns and hostas.
map.西向夏季午后强光高温，宜选耐晒品种（太阳花、仙人掌）或加遮阳网，避免娇嫩叶菜灼伤: A west-facing balcony gets strong light and high temperature in the afternoon in summer, so choose sun-tolerant varieties (portulaca, cactus) or add shade netting to avoid scorching tender leafy vegetables.
map.光照不足如何补？: How do I compensate for insufficient light?
map.可补植物补光灯（全光谱 LED，每日 12-16h），或改用耐阴品种，减少开花类: Add a plant grow light (full spectrum LED, 12-16h daily), or switch to shade-tolerant varieties and reduce the proportion of flowering plants.
map.直射光照：南向 4-8h / 东向 3-5h / 西向 2.5-6h / 北向: Direct light: south 4-8h / east 3-5h / west 2.5-6h / north 0.5-2h (by season)
map.楼层修正：低层 -1h、高层 +0.5h: Floor correction: low floor -1h, high floor +0.5h
map.全日照≥6h、半日照 4-6h、散射光 2-4h、耐阴<2h: Full sun ≥6h, half sun 4-6h, diffuse light 2-4h, shade tolerant <2h
map.西向夏季注意遮阴，结果供选花参考: Watch for shading on west-facing balconies in summer; results are a reference for choosing plants
